description: Sent by Jabeer via FMOS after the sales meeting. All document templates (proposal, agreement, invoice) are generated or attached in FMOS, previewed by Jabeer, then sent via WhatsApp as PDF document messages. Covers the full closing sequence from proposal to invoice.

templates.label: Proposal Sent

fmosFlow.flow1: FMOS-generated proposal — Jabeer clicks Generate Proposal → previews PDF → hits Send → FMOS sends PDF + message
fmosFlow.flow2: External proposal — Jabeer creates proposal outside FMOS → attaches PDF in FMOS → hits Send → FMOS sends PDF + message

templates.message:
Hi {{name}}! 😊

Really good speaking with you today. Here's the proposal for {{businessName}} — everything we discussed is in there, services, pricing, and timelines.

Have a look when you get a chance and let me know if you have any questions.

— Jabeer, FortuneMarq

templates.label: Proposal Follow-Up (48hrs no reply)
templates.message:
Hi {{name}}! 👋

Just checking in — did you get a chance to look at the proposal I sent across?

No rush at all — just wanted to make sure it reached you okay and see if you have any questions.

— Jabeer, FortuneMarq

templates.label: Agreement Request
templates.fmosFlow: Jabeer generates agreement document in FMOS with selected services → previews → hits Send → FMOS sends PDF + message. Lead replies manually with text ('Yes, confirmed'). FMOS webhook catches the reply and notifies Jabeer.
templates.note: Lead must reply with typed text — no button. Typed agreement is more deliberate and carries more weight.
templates.message:
Hi {{name}}! 😊

Great to know you'd like to move forward! Please find the service agreement attached — have a read through.

Just to recap what we're starting with:
✅ {{service1}}
✅ {{service2}}

If everything looks good, simply reply to this message with "Yes, confirmed" and we'll get started.

— Jabeer, FortuneMarq

templates.label: Invoice Sent
templates.fmosFlow: Jabeer generates invoice in FMOS → previews → hits Send → FMOS sends PDF + message.
templates.message:
Hi {{name}}! 🎉

Welcome to FortuneMarq! Please find your invoice attached.

Once payment is done, we'll start immediately. Onboarding checklist will come right after so we can get everything we need from your end quickly.

Excited to get started on this!

— Jabeer, FortuneMarq
